model: Integer finite on-shell reaction incidence S (vector −1, neutrino+1, antineutrino+1); two daughter grid origins; mV=.4 Emax=4
method: Independent exact Gaussian elimination in finite fields primes 1000003,1000033; float SVD; local optional SymPy exact ranks at h=.4,.2
analytic_origin: Integer grid top neutrino k=Emax impossible for vector E<=Emax with positive other daughter; same for antineutrino, two identically zero stoichiometric rows, hence 2 additional exact conserved endpoint populations.
positive: Shifted half-offset angular-overlap removes those isolated states for tested masses/resolutions; nullspace contains exactly physical C,L,E.
negative: Physical event entropy and exact C/L/E alone do not ensure unique physical equilibrium; integer graph has two extra conserved occupations and can never erase their initial memory regardless of dt.
limitations: Mass and cutoff scoped; not complete ν/eγ SM, not continuum dynamics, no chi Gammael, 86eV ΩDM/BEC/CLASS, further approximate eigenmodes possible.
